% 07.07.2025 Cm Appl. 38863/2025 (application for withdrawal of the writ petition) & W.P.(C)
1 .  The petitioner has filed this application for permission to withdraw the writ petition.
The application is supported by affidavit of the petitioner, and the petitioner has also appeared on video conference.
She confirms that she does not wish to proceed with the writ petition for personal reasons.
2. In view of the above, the application is allowed, and W.P.(C) 11551/2023 is dismissed as withdrawn.
3. The next date of hearing, i.e., 18.07.2025 stands cancelled.
